entries.zh: 气息/风气通过：吐气、排气（呼吸出入）
entries.en: to pass wind or breath; to breathe out
entries.notes: H 作「朝氣」，M 却读 tiān quy（合「天氣」thian-khì），字形与音写不符；仅西语「pasar el viento, o resuello」之气息出入义可定，汉文对应无法定夺。

entries.zh: （日子）勉强过得去；捱日子
entries.en: to get by in life; to manage to live
entries.notes: H 作「直過」，当为「得過」(tit-kuè) 之借字，方合「puedese pasar（尚可度日）」。

entries.zh: 度日；勉强维生
entries.en: to get along, to get by day by day

entries.zh: 托人疏通放行；借他人之力通过
entries.en: to get something passed through by entrusting it to someone; to have it smoothed through
entries.notes: L 栏空缺，仅据 H「托通過」与 M tog thong cue 定夺；亦可解作推托使通过。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔original damaged; gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: H、M、R 三栏皆空，仅存西语「pasar de golpe」（一下子过去、猛然通过），无汉文可据。

entries.zh: 温习书本；手持书卷通读
entries.en: to go over a book; to read a book through by hand

entries.zh: 把功课温习到熟；念熟背熟
entries.en: to go over a lesson until it is thoroughly familiar; to learn it by heart

entries.zh: 跨过去；从上方越过
entries.en: to step over; to pass over the top of something
entries.notes: H 标[疑:跌/跋]；M hua cue chu 近「跨過去」(hōa-kuè-khì)，义取跨越，原字未能定。

entries.zh: 火焰蔓延过去；火势烧越
entries.en: for flame to sweep across; for fire to spread over
entries.notes: H 标[疑:焰/燄]，为异体字，于义无碍。

entries.zh: 越级、跳级；逾越次序
entries.en: to skip over ranks or grades; to leap past the proper order
entries.notes: H 标[疑:芋/芧]，然 M lap teng 与西语「pasar por salto, pasar orden」相合，当为「躐等」(lia̍p-téng)。

entries.zh: 历经世代；一一历数（岁月）
entries.en: to pass through the ages; to go through them one by one
entries.notes: H 标[疑:上/卜]，与 M 之 leg leg 不合；仅「歷」义可定，次字存疑。

entries.zh: 历经一代又一代；历代相继
entries.en: to pass through age after age; through successive generations

entries.zh: 经年累月；历经多年
entries.en: to pass year after year; over many years

entries.zh: 落在时机之后；错过机会
entries.en: to fall behind the occasion; to let the chance slip

entries.zh: 错过治病用药的时机；病过可治之期
entries.en: for the time for the remedy to pass; to miss the moment of cure
entries.notes: H「過証」扞格，疑为「過症」；M cue chin 与二字音近，义依西语定。

entries.zh: 一天天慢慢过去；渐度时日
entries.en: to pass the days little by little

entries.zh: （事）越过头、失于过甚（未及预防）
entries.en: to overshoot, to go too far (without having foreseen it)
entries.notes: L「pre= venir」为分行连字符，读作 prevenir；「pasarse」有过头义，与 H「過頭」相合。

entries.zh: 摸不着头绪；全然不懂
entries.en: not to know where to begin; to have no idea

entries.zh: 纸张洇透；墨透纸背
entries.en: for the paper to soak through; for ink to bleed through
entries.notes: H 标[疑:濡/濕]，二字义近，不影响释义。

entries.zh: 逾期；误了期限
entries.en: to miss the deadline; to run past the term
entries.notes: M 仅记 tan 一音节，不足对应 H 双字「遲限」，然义仍可定。

entries.zh: 迟误、延误（误了期限）
entries.en: to delay and miss; to be late for a term

entries.zh: 消遣、玩乐；自娱取乐
entries.en: pastime, amusement; to enjoy oneself, to treat oneself
entries.notes: M「Guan loy」次音节未能对应汉字，H 仅一字「玩」；L 之「j.」当为 juego（游戏）。
